newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Primary elevator space across the Canadian Prairies continued to contract in the week ended Feb 9 to a regional average of 20 percent, Canadian Wheat Board said.
Manitoba posted the tightest elevator vacancy rate at 17 percent, followed by Saskatchewan at 20 percent and Alberta at 21 percent.
"Warmer weather has allowed farmers to clear snow, open up their bins and haul grain to elevators," a CWB statement said.
Railcar unloads at Vancouver fell well below the 3,000 target for the week ended Feb 9 at 1,994 hopper cars unloaded.
Railcar unloads at Prince Rupert reached 1,160 compared to the target of 1,300.
